answers.valueEn: The car is completely worn out internally including seat upholstery, front right door speaker, door handles, and light switch. Impact on the condenser and front radiator. Rust on the lower parts of the car. Welding traces on the exhaust flap motor. Engine and gearbox under-shields are missing. Two rear tensioners are bent. Tires are worn out. Minor impact on the front subframe. Hammering marks on the front right knuckle. Repair traces on the steering box. Leak from turbo oil and water pipes. New gearbox oil pan. Severe impacts on the car floor. Corrosion (Baroma) in the floor near the front right door. Windshield washer nozzle bar needs repair. Washer fluid reservoir is broken. Traces of headlight and taillight lens replacement. Exhaust sound is muffled. Steering wheel is faded/peeling. Gear stick lights not working (needs control unit). Sunroof mechanism and control issues. Car performance is restricted and exhaust sound is abnormal. Engine roughness.
